nalli:10605807501611.description: Discover Raadhya, a Kanchipuram silk saree featuring evenly spaced Paisa buttas and delicate floral zari creeper borders. The Konia pallu brings together a rare geometric design, intricate floral Jaal, broad zari bands and ornamental stripes, with raised dimensional detailing created through intricate stitching.

nalli:10605808582955.description: Discover Leela, a Kanchipuram silk saree featuring evenly spaced Paisa coin motifs in gold and silver zari. Traditional Kuyilkann diamond lattice borders are framed with Mutthu Seeru, floral vine and Mayil motifs, while the contrast pallu brings together decorative stripes, floral pet and intricate zari detailing, finished with a central zari panel.

nalli:10605822181675.description: Swarna, reflecting the warm glow of gold, comes alive in a Kanjeevaram rich with zari detail. Its Ganga Jamuna Korvai border features a Kamalam pet topped with zari Vairosi. The body carries Mayil butas woven with silver zari Meenakari and smaller Manga motifs, while the pallu brings together Mayil butas, floral pet, geometric brocade and Vanki stripes.

nalli:10605807436075.description: Discover Mridula, a traditional Mubaggam Kanjeevaram silk saree with three contrasting sections, Korwai borders and pallu. Mayil butas with Arakku Meena detailing enrich the body, while temple-inspired zari borders and a heavy zari pallu reflect its time-intensive craftsmanship and characteristic fall.

nalli:10605808386347.description: Megha unfolds in a traditional Arai Pagam Kanjeevaram, bringing together two distinct coloured panels through the Korvai technique. Temple motifs mark the joinery, while Chakram, Mayil and Kamalam butas enrich the body. A minimal Chakram border and Ghetti pallu echo the same motif, creating a simple, balanced design. Soft in expression and rich in tradition, Megha brings the changing forms of a cloud to the weave.
